integrity.claim_scope: Labelled \(K_{n,n,n}\), integers \(n\ge2\), uniformly random single-site closed-neighborhood minority updates with tie-induced flips.
integrity.finite_checks: Two standalone exhaustive implementations: full transition SCC n=1..4; constructive paths, optimum census and cut-flux n=1..6.
integrity.proof_basis: Direct inequalities, multilinear exact max-cut classification, constructive absorption path, six glued hypercubes, reversible stationary flow and total-variation lower bound.

scientific_limitations: No upper mixing-time bound, exact spectral gap, or absorption-time distribution is proved.
Only balanced three-part complete graphs with n >= 2 are covered.
Historical priority is qualified: unindexed literature may contain an equivalent ground-state flip classification.
title: A six-hypercube max-cut attractor and exponential mixing bottleneck on \(K_{n,n,n}\)
